declared.title: Eight-minute self-regulation intervention raises educational attainment at scale in individualist but not collectivist cultures
declared.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
declared.foundIn: cited by kizilcec-2020-scale (full text, ref. 14); Crossref search « Kizilcec Cohen eight-minute self-regulation intervention raises educational attainment at scale » (2026-11-23)

population: 17,963 learners in online courses, two randomized experiments; countries grouped as individualist or collectivist (e.g. India, China)

findings.text: In individualist cultures, learners who did MCII were more likely to complete the course than after a control activity

support.sentence: Learners in individualist cultures were 32% (first experiment) and 15% (second experiment) more likely to complete the course following the MCII intervention than a control activity.

findings.text: In collectivist cultures, MCII did not change course completion

support.sentence: In contrast, learners in collectivist cultures were unaffected by MCII.

limits: countries grouped as individualist or collectivist; Arab countries not reported separately
online learners and course completion; MCII helped only with predictable, surmountable obstacles
the authors' scaled-up test (kizilcec-2020-scale) found no effect of MCII on completion
